outline.heading: Source-grounding: the answer is tied to a source

points.text: The notebook works differently: before answering, it finds the relevant pieces in your sources and builds the answer on them.
A citation is not a decoration — it is a seam.
The notebook knows only what you gave it.
For the notebook, a video is its transcript.

outline.heading: Under the hood — in module 05 language

points.text: If you took the context-and-memory module, you will recognize the mechanics: sources are cut into chunks, the chunks relevant to your question are retrieved, and they are placed into the model's context with the instruction "answer only from this." A notebook is managed context with mandatory citations — not a different kind of magic.
The model then answers with general knowledge plus your sources — and questions about the notebook come back with links into it.
